storage: Keep in an airtight steel or glass container in a cool dry place for 2 to 3 months, or in the fridge in hot, humid Mumbai monsoon weather to slow insects and rancidity.
looksLike: Fine, light brown to creamy-beige flour with small bran specks; soft to the touch with a mild wheaty smell.
howToPick: Look for a recent packing date, an even light-brown colour with bran flecks, a fresh nutty smell and a sealed pack. Avoid flour that smells musty or sour, feels damp or has lumps or tiny insects.
shelfLife: Packaged atta is usually labelled for a few months from packing; whole wheat flour goes stale sooner than maida because of the germ oil (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
